'''Jona Grumby''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] naval officer who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], and later in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Picket Fleet/Legends|Picket Fleet]].

==Biography==
A distinguished [[Captain/Legends|captain]], Grumby accumulated a total of thirty years of service in the Imperial Navy, as well as a different fleet prior to that. During the [[Battle of Ogoth Tiir/Legends|Battle]] of [[Ogoth Tiir/Legends|Ogoth Tiir]], Grumby sustained injuries and was rendered unable to walk. Despite his reputation as a quick thinker and fearless captain, he was forced to retire. Using a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hover-chair]] for mobility, Grumby was agitated by the inactivity that had been forced upon him because he felt he could still be an effective commander.

Recruiters for the Corporate Sector Authority's Picket Fleet apparently held the same viewpoint and requested his services. Within the Picket Fleet, Grumby trained new officers and captured a large number of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. He attained the rank of [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]] in the process of doing so and was expected to be eventually promoted to [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]].
